_notes: SI units. Conversions: 1 kg·cm = 0.0980665 N·m; s/60° -> rad/s = (π/3)/t; rpm -> rad/s = rpm·2π/60.

'RATED_RULE': most hobby servos and Dynamixels publish only stall torque. Where no continuous rating is published, rated_torque_nm = stall/3, the ratio Feetech publishes for the STS3215 (6.5 / 19.5 kg·cm). Treat these as estimates.
Prices are single-unit retail and change often; they are for ranking designs, not quoting.
no_load_speed_rad_s: output speed with no load. The sim uses a linear torque-speed line from rated torque at 0 to zero torque at this speed.
kind: hobby_servo / dynamixel / stepper; decides the simulated controller gains and torque-speed model (see taskbot/sim/motor.py).
AX-12A is kind hobby_servo: it uses compliance margin/slope instead of PID gains, so it gets the documented conservative hobby setting.
modes: which control loops a motor supports here. Arm joints and grippers need position, wheels need velocity.
dc_gearmotor: brushed DC gearmotors with encoders, velocity mode only, driven by a speed controller with one conservative PI preset (taskbot/sim/motor.py).
